limitations: This packet supplies retained HN-factor closure rows for every nonzero HN factor occurrence.
It verifies each factor against the retained class, semistable substack, and closed substack rows.

It does not prove compactified extension or two-step flag stacks, subquotient closure in flag stacks, cosection atlases, transitions, Pfaffian orientations, or protected traces. Dual closure is supplied by certificates/moduli/retained_dual_closure.
